warmgate_pipeline.description: Curated init-pipeline warm-gate pipeline entries (v11 §CR-1/CR-6): one verified single-generation fork_coll collective and one verified-safe mpi_coll collective. Each carries an explicit, non-wildcard test_filter matching exactly one gtest case (enforced by the binary-backed --gtest_list_tests preflight). Fault-injection / GDR-flush / visibility-mismatch / plugin-lifecycle / first-init-semantics / NetIb / P2P tests are deliberately excluded.

tests.name: warmgate_fork_allreduce
tests.description: Pinned single-generation fork collective. Replace test_filter with the exact suite.case verified on your build; the preflight rejects a zero- or multi-match filter.

tests.name: warmgate_mpi_allreduce
tests.description: Verified-safe MPI collective that PASSED in an earlier run. Replace test_filter with the exact suite.case; must NOT be a fault-injection / GDR-flush / visibility-mismatch / first-init-semantics case.

warmgate_serial.description: Host-only serial control (warmup_profile none): must receive NEITHER RCCL_TEST_WARMUP_PROFILE NOR rendezvous env, and must never be launched by the loader.

tests.name: warmgate_serial_control
tests.description: Replace test_filter with a real host-only test in your build; kept serial by policy.

test_suites.name: warmgate_serial
test_suites.description: Host-only serial control (second suite -> proves one run-wide scheduler spans suites).
